name: Loro Parque Fundación annual conservation project call
summary: Yearly call for endangered-species conservation and research projects backed by an NGO, university or conservation centre, with priority for parrots, marine species and high-value ecosystems. The amount is not stated.

calls.label: Annual call for funding (yearly 31 July close)
calls.recurring: Proposals close on 31 July; the 2027 call opened in June 2026

status.quote: Proposals can be submitted until 31 July through the Foundation's official website

recurring.quote: Proposals can be submitted until 31 July through the Foundation's official website

applicant_types.quote: Submitted projects must relate to endangered species and be supported by an NGO, university, conservation centre or other recognised scientific or conservation organisation.

geography.quote: Conservation projects around the world Browse the interactive map and learn more about the projects supported by Loro Parque Fundación

access.quote: Interested organisations must complete and submit their proposal through the official form before 31 July.

window.quote: Applications may be submitted until 31 July through the form available on the Foundation's official website.
